failure_patterns.pattern: rule_ignored: The agent returned a clue detail or related expression instead of the requested answer slot, despite existing guidance on implicit clues, quoted fragments, and place prompts.

rejected_edits.content: Use the canonical name form supported by the clue and context, not merely the shortest uniquely identifying string. Give the complete identifying name when needed, and retain conventional name components or honorifics when sources present them as part of the expected form; use a shorter form when it is itself the conventional answer form and remains unambiguous.
rejected_edits.target: Use a name form that uniquely identifies the entity: give the complete identifying name when needed, but a surname or shorter form is appropriate when it is unambiguous.

rejected_edits.content: When a clue asks what an acronym or initialism stands for, or identifies a feature by its abbreviation, give the conventional expanded phrase rather than repeating the abbreviation or supplying a related generic description. Use context to disambiguate the expansion.
